The testkit: the snapshot runner that renders UIs on a hidden surface, the snapshot suite and the contract suites that check a backend, and the tools that compare renders.
Learn: [Testing your UIs](/use/learn/running/testing/), [Testing a backend](/build/testing-a-backend/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`BitmapFontContractSuite`](/reference/testing/bitmapfontcontractsuite/) | class | The contract tests of the drawing of bitmap fonts by a render bridge: whole texels and the same ink at every scale. |
| [`BorrowedTextureContractSuite`](/reference/testing/borrowedtexturecontractsuite/) | class | The contract tests of the textures that a backend borrows from its host. |
| [`ContractDraw`](/reference/testing/contractdraw/) | class | The helpers of the contract suites, for contract tests of your own: a frame around a drawing, quads and vertices, a shader from a fragment stage, a pixel assertion. |
| [`GlslExport`](/reference/testing/glslexport/) | class | Writes every built-in shader of JOID translated to every GLSL dialect, to check a translation with the compilers of each dialect. |
| [`IBorrowedTextureBackend`](/reference/testing/iborrowedtexturebackend/) | interface | A snapshot backend that can create, lend and inspect a texture of its host, for the borrowed texture suite. |
| [`ISnapshotBackend`](/reference/testing/isnapshotbackend/) | interface | A hidden surface on which a backend is registered, that the testkit draws on and captures. |
| [`IStateGuardBackend`](/reference/testing/istateguardbackend/) | interface | A snapshot backend that can draw and set state like a host, for the state guard suite. |
| [`JarCheck`](/reference/testing/jarcheck/) | class | Starts JOID from a packaged jar, opens a UI, draws 60 frames and exits with the result, for the jar checks of a backend. |
| [`RenderBridgeContractSuite`](/reference/testing/renderbridgecontractsuite/) | class | The contract tests of a render bridge, run on your snapshot backend in a few seconds. |
| [`SnapshotAudioSource`](/reference/testing/snapshotaudiosource/) | class | An audio source that plays nothing, so that snapshot tests need no sound device. |
| [`SnapshotBaseline`](/reference/testing/snapshotbaseline/) | class | Renders every snapshot scenario with a given snapshot backend into a folder, the baseline that the other backends are compared with. |
| [`SnapshotBridgeRestorer`](/reference/testing/snapshotbridgerestorer/) | class | Remembers the bridges of every registry and later unregisters every bridge registered since. |
| [`SnapshotComparison`](/reference/testing/snapshotcomparison/) | class | Compares the renders of several backends with those of a reference backend, and writes a report. |
| [`SnapshotDifference`](/reference/testing/snapshotdifference/) | class | How much two snapshot images differ: the number of pixels beyond the tolerance and the largest channel difference. |
| [`SnapshotEntry`](/reference/testing/snapshotentry/) | class | One shot of a snapshot report: its name, its status, its different pixels and its two files. |
| [`SnapshotImage`](/reference/testing/snapshotimage/) | class | The pixels of a snapshot, as opaque ARGB `int` values row after row from the top-left corner. |
| [`SnapshotReport`](/reference/testing/snapshotreport/) | class | Writes the HTML report of a snapshot run, with every shot next to its reference. |
| [`SnapshotRunner`](/reference/testing/snapshotrunner/) | class | Runs commands and scenarios on a hidden 1920×1080 surface with a manual clock, and returns the shots by name. |
| [`SnapshotSettings`](/reference/testing/snapshotsettings/) | class | The system properties of a snapshot run: where the references and the renders go, and whether the references are recorded. |
| [`SnapshotStatus`](/reference/testing/snapshotstatus/) | enum | What happened to a shot in a snapshot run. |
| [`SnapshotSuite`](/reference/testing/snapshotsuite/) | class | The snapshot tests of a backend: every scenario of the testkit, pixel for pixel against the references of the machine. |
| [`SnapshotUIBridge`](/reference/testing/snapshotuibridge/) | class | The UI bridge of the snapshot runner: a window bridge with a `#323232` background and an interface scale that the scenarios set. |
| [`SnapshotUrlAssetLocator`](/reference/testing/snapshoturlassetlocator/) | class | Downloads an `http` or `https` resource once into the `snapshot` area of the cache folder, so that later snapshot runs work offline. |
| [`SnapshotWindowBridge`](/reference/testing/snapshotwindowbridge/) | class | The window bridge of the snapshot runner, whose size, mouse, held keys, cursor and clipboard the commands set. |
| [`StateGuardContractSuite`](/reference/testing/stateguardcontractsuite/) | class | The contract tests of a render bridge that shares its graphics context with a host: every frame must look the same and give the host its state back, whatever the host left set. |
| [`StateTrap`](/reference/testing/statetrap/) | enum | A state that a host may leave set before a frame of JOID, which [`StateGuardContractSuite`](/reference/testing/stateguardcontractsuite/) sets to check that JOID draws the same anyway. |
